name: Kastelan Robot

bonuses.name: Repulsor Grid
bonuses.text: A Kastelan Robot has a Force Shield with AV *5. When attempting to soak wounds, if two or more 6s are rolled on the soak roll, the enemy that made the attack suffers a mortal wound.

bonuses.name: Battle Protocols
bonuses.text: Kastelan Robots can have one of three battle protocols active at a time. A Kastelan Robot begins combat with Aegis Protocol active and cannot change to another except by the actions of a Cybernetica Datasmith.

bonuses.name: Aegis Protocol
bonuses.text: The Kastelan robot adds 2 to its resilience and increases the AV of its Repulsor Grid force shield to 7.

bonuses.name: Conqueror Protocol
bonuses.text: The Kastelan cannot fire any ranged weapons it has equipped, but may ignore up to 2DN penalty for making a melee Multi-Attack.

bonuses.name: Protector Protocol
bonuses.text: The Kastelan cannot use any melee weapons it has equipped and cannot move, but doubles the Salvo rating for all its ranged weapons.

bonuses.name: Battle-Automata
bonuses.text: A Robot is not alive, and therefore ignores any effects that would affect the mind or physiology, such as poisons, radiation, disease, or mind-affecting psychic powers. A Robot does not have a toughness, willpower, fellowship, resolve or conviction score and is considered to automatically pass those tests if it is required to make them, except where the GM determines otherwise.

abilities.name: Attacks
abilities.text: A Kastelan Robot is generally found in one of two configurations:

options.name: Kastelan Fists and Incendine Combustor
options.text: Kastelan Fists (18+2ED; AP-3; Brutal) Incendine Combustor (12+2ED; AP-1; Range 16m; Salvo 2; Blast (Large), Blaze, Heavy (6), Spread)

options.name: 3x Heavy Phosphor Blaster
options.text: 3x Heavy Phosphor Blaster (14+2ED; AP-2; 72m; Salvo 3; Blaze, Heavy (6), Phosphor). All three Phosphor Blasters may be fired individually each turn.

note: Toughness, Willpower, Fellowship, Resolve, Conviction print "--" (null; see Battle-Automata). Treated as a vehicle for most purposes; this profile covers the Kastelan and its "pilot". The table prints Keywords Robot, Imperium, Adeptus Mechanicus, <FORGE WORLD>; the text under it prints Battle-Automata, Imperium, Adeptus Mechanicus, <FORGE WORLD>; table kept. Value: 14 (Unique).
